records.edition: Louis de La Vallee Poussin tradition; cross-check against Sanskrit/Tibetan/Chinese witnesses required
records.source_date_range: late 4th-5th century CE text; witness dates vary
records.operational_definition: 120 ksana = 1 tatksana; 60 tatksana = 1 lava; 30 lava = 1 muhurta; 30 muhurta = 1 day-night
records.anchor_uncertainty: SI conversion depends on choosing a modern day length; the textual ratio itself is exact within this source profile
records.citation: Abhidharmakosa III.88-89; 120 kṣaṇa = tatkṣaṇa, 60 tatkṣaṇa = lava, 30 lava = muhūrta, 30 muhūrta = ahorātra
records.notes: Do not merge with kṣaṇa definitions from Purana, Vinaya or other Abhidharma traditions.

records.edition: web Sanskrit witnesses used for bootstrap; critical-edition verification required
records.operational_definition: 3 nimesa = 1 ksana; 5 ksana = 1 kastha; 15 kastha = 1 laghu; 15 laghu = 1 nadika; 2 nadika = 1 muhurta; 30 muhurta = 1 day-night
records.anchor_uncertainty: SI conversion depends on day calibration; textual chain remains exact within this profile
records.notes: At 86400 s per day-night this source-qualified kṣaṇa calibrates to 1.28 s; this is not the Abhidharmakosa kṣaṇa.

records.recension: Shamasastry translation profile; Sanskrit critical witness verification required
records.operational_definition: 2 truti = 1 lava; 2 lava = 1 nimesa; 5 nimesa = 1 kastha; 30 kastha = 1 kala; 40 kala = 1 nalika; 2 nalika = 1 muhurta; 15 muhurta = one day or one night
records.anchor_uncertainty: The text separately states 15 muhurtas per day or night; full 24-hour calibration therefore uses 30 muhurtas.
records.citation: Arthasastra II.20, Measurement of Space and Time
records.notes: Exact chain gives 1,440,000 truṭi per full day-night, hence 0.06 s only after a modern 86400 s/day calibration.

records.edition: web Sanskrit witnesses used for bootstrap; critical-edition verification required
records.operational_definition: 100 truti = 1 vedha; 3 vedha = 1 lava; 3 lava = 1 nimesa; 3 nimesa = 1 ksana; 5 ksana = 1 kastha; 15 kastha = 1 laghu; 15 laghu = 1 nadika; 2 nadika = 1 muhurta; 30 muhurta = 1 day-night
records.anchor_uncertainty: SI conversion is a modern calibration; the text's own operational language links truṭi to motion/integration of trasareṇu.
records.notes: Exact chain gives 182,250,000 truṭi per day-night; at 86400 s this is about 474.074 microseconds.
